message.subject: PH-100: two-year planning and revised pricing
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

We value our long partnership and want a viable two-year agreement that gives your team planning certainty.

The price history in po:4500001201 and po:4500001288 is our starting point for assessing the increase.
The should-cost assessment cost:part:PH-100 supports a more moderate adjustment than the proposed increase.
Please reconcile the notice in doc:D01-LETTER with the requirement in ctr:D01-FRAMEWORK before bringing the increase into effect.

We propose these alternatives, all for a 24-month contract, with 4,000 housings annually and unchanged FCA / 35-day lead time:
A: EUR 49.58 per unit, payment 60 days net, effective 2027-04-01.
B: EUR 49.19 per unit, payment 30 days net, effective 2027-04-01.
C: EUR 49.14 per unit, payment 30 days net, effective 2027-02-01.

The 30-day options provide earlier cash in exchange for price, while the two-year commitment supports capacity planning. Which package best fits your operation? Please also share your full per-unit cost breakdown, including energy, labour, material and overhead, and explain the remaining drivers beyond the wage increase you identified.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

batch.note: Offer planning certainty and cash alternatives; request full cost before estimating sustainable margin. Named case evidence cited without unrecorded figures.

trace.final_text: Sent three alternative packages and requested the foundry’s full cost breakdown.

message.subject: SH-220: alternative commercial packages
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,

Thank you for the quotation. The competing quote offer:DEMO-C1-0 is €16.00 per shaft.
Our should-cost benchmark cost:part:SH-220 supports a review of the machining price.
Please use the demand outlook fc:SH-220@2026-09 when assessing the 24-month programme.

We propose these alternatives, each with 35-day lead time:
A: €12.78/unit, 60 days net, DAP.
B: €12.65/unit, 14 days net, DAP.
C: €12.06/unit, 14 days net, EXW.
The earlier-payment options and longer lead time give you flexibility in exchange for the price reduction. Which package best fits your workshop? Please also share your per-unit breakdown for material, machining and overhead so we can address the main drivers.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

message.subject: SH-220: price, payment and delivery alternatives
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your proposal. Our should-cost benchmark cost:part:SH-220 supports a lower machining price.
Please consider the programme demand outlook fc:SH-220@2026-09 in your pricing.
Your quality record sc:DEMO-C1@2026Q3 also needs to be reflected in a competitive overall package.

For the 24-month programme we propose three alternatives, all with 35-day lead time:
A: €12.39/unit, 60 days net, DAP.
B: €12.27/unit, 14 days net, DAP.
C: €11.67/unit, 14 days net, EXW.
Early payment is available against the corresponding price reduction; EXW is also an option. Please identify the package that suits your operations and provide your material, machining and overhead cost breakdown. Delivery must be brought within our requirement rather than the standard 45 days.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Explore early payment and freight trade-offs, anchor below likely floors, request cost breakdowns and bring Polish lead time into compliance.

trace.final_text: Sent both suppliers three alternative packages and requested their cost breakdowns.

message.subject: Re: SH-220: EXW and early payment
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,

Thank you for the price movement and the attached calculation. We will retain the 14-day payment you prefer and EXW collection, with 35-day lead time. I can move our EXW proposal to €12.16 per unit on those terms.

The delivery performance record sc:DEMO-J1@2026Q3 should also be considered when reviewing the package.
Your calculation groups overhead and profit together at €1.94 per unit; could you separate those elements and review the machining allowance for the 24-month programme? Please take this revised proposal into your internal price review.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Small price move while preserving supplier's preferred early payment and EXW. Await rival response; do not accept while German supplier remains open.

message.subject: PH-100: revised 24-month package
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for taking the evidence into account and extending the agreement to 24 months. We understand your preference to keep internal costs confidential; an indication of the changes in scrap and gas costs, without disclosing your detailed accounts, would help us understand the adjustment.

The on-time delivery record in sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q3 is also relevant to the balance of price and supply reliability in this agreement.

We can increase our April package to EUR 49.25 per unit, payment 30 days net, contract 24 months, effective 2027-04-01, with 4,000 housings annually and unchanged FCA / 35-day lead time. This retains your preferred payment terms and the longer planning commitment. Please review the price on that basis.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

batch.note: Small price movement on supplier-preferred 30-day/24-month structure. Full cost estimate provisional; no detailed cost data available.

trace.final_text: Sent a small revised offer, retaining early payment and EXW collection.
Sent a small price concession while retaining 30-day payment and the two-year agreement.

message.subject: Re: SH-220: competitive 35-day package
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for confirming 35 days and for the quality response. We do not require 28-day overtime delivery; please price the 35-day schedule without that premium.
The competing offer offer:DEMO-J1-1 is €14.70 per unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW.

We can move our proposals to €12.37/unit DAP or €11.77/unit EXW, both with 14 days net and 35-day lead time. Please retain the early-payment benefit in your calculation and review the accelerated-schedule surcharge: the revised price is higher than your opening price despite earlier payment.
I respect your cost-disclosure policy; please explain the delivery surcharge and whether a 42-day schedule would remove it, without sharing confidential cost detail.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Use verified lower rival offer and make small price concession. Clarify premium rather than pay for unwanted 28-day overtime.

trace.final_text: Sent revised packages and cited the lower rival offer, asking for clarification of the delivery surcharge.

message.subject: PH-100: further revision on the April package
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the further reduction. We recognise that scrap and gas affect your operation, and we are retaining the two-year commitment and your standard payment terms to support predictable production and cash flow.

The on-time delivery record in sc:DEMO-F1@2026Q2 provides additional context for balancing supply performance and the price adjustment.

We can revise our proposal to EUR 49.30 per unit, payment 30 days net, contract 24 months, effective 2027-04-01; annual volume remains 4,000 housings, with FCA and 35-day lead time unchanged. Please review what further price adjustment you can make on this package.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

batch.note: Supplier remains open and moved; small EUR0.05 price concession preserves room for its next step.

trace.final_text: Sent a further €0.05 price concession and requested another reduction.

message.subject: PH-100: price or earlier implementation
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Understood: we will not ask you to count the delivery record twice. Let us focus instead on a commercial trade that supports your recovery of costs.

We offer two revised alternatives, both with payment 30 days net and a 24-month contract:
A: EUR 49.35 per unit, effective 2027-04-01.
B: EUR 49.25 per unit, effective 2027-02-01.

Option B brings the adjustment forward in exchange for a lower unit price, as you previously indicated an interest in February implementation. Annual volume remains 4,000 housings and FCA / 35-day lead time remains unchanged. Please review both packages and indicate the price you can support against each implementation date.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

batch.note: Avoid duplicate evidence; introduce earlier effective date as real concession and small price rise on April package.

trace.final_text: Sent two revised packages, trading earlier implementation for a lower price.

message.subject: Re: SH-220: planning flexibility against price
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for reviewing the planning and early-payment benefit. We can now allow 42-day lead time for an EXW package at €11.77/unit, 14 days net. This gives you an additional week to schedule machining without overtime; please translate that flexibility into the price.
Alternatively, we can increase our DAP proposal to €12.47/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time.
Please review both packages with your pricing authority. You mentioned material accounts for about 45% of cost; is scheduling capacity or material procurement the main obstacle to a more competitive price?

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Small concession via permissible 42-day planning flexibility; alternative small DAP price increase. No unused relevant verified argument remains.

trace.final_text: Offered additional scheduling flexibility in exchange for a lower price.

message.subject: Re: SH-220: revised EXW proposal
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,

Thank you for the internal review. I respect that your margin stays confidential. We need no overtime or 21-day premium; the 35-day schedule is suitable.

I can increase our proposal to €12.26/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW. With your available capacity, please review the machining allowance for this 24-month programme while retaining the early payment you value. We will handle collection under EXW.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Small price concession, maintain cash and freight preferences. Respect confidentiality and use supplier's free-capacity statement rather than repeat data IDs.

trace.final_text: Sent a small price increase while retaining the supplier’s preferred payment and collection terms.

message.subject: PH-100: February implementation package
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for confirming that February implementation enables a lower price. We will focus on that structure, retaining the 30-day payment terms and the two-year planning commitment.

We can increase the February proposal to EUR 49.30 per unit, payment 30 days net, contract 24 months, effective 2027-02-01. Annual volume remains 4,000 housings, FCA, with a 35-day lead time.

Please review your price further against this revised package and return your February terms as the main offer rather than an alternative description.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

batch.note: Small concession on preferred earlier-start structure; request formal standing February sheet.

trace.final_text: Sent a small concession on the February package and requested a formal standing offer.
Accepted: €50.40 per housing, 30-day payment, 24-month contract, effective 1 April 2027.

message.subject: Re: SH-220: factual price basis and revised proposal
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for reflecting the scheduling flexibility. The current market evidence is offer:DEMO-J1-2 at €14.00/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW.
This is a directly comparable shaft quotation, with shorter delivery than your 42-day package; it is the factual commercial basis for requesting a more competitive price. We are not claiming access to your confidential manufacturing costs.

We can increase our proposal to €11.87/unit, 14 days net, 42-day lead time, EXW. Please review it with your pricing authority, retaining the extra scheduling week and early-payment benefit.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Answer request for factual basis with newly verified rival standing offer; make only a small price move.

trace.final_text: Answered the request for evidence with the latest rival quote and sent a small revised offer.

message.subject: Re: SH-220: offer received
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,

Thank you. We have recorded your final offer at €13.90/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW, for the 24-month programme. We are completing the quotation comparison and will communicate the award decision separately. No overtime delivery is required.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Do not push final German offer. Acknowledge while Polish revised response is in flight; next use German final price against Polish bidder before award.

trace.final_text: Acknowledged the final offer without reopening negotiations; the other supplier’s response is pending.

batch.note: Accept refreshed German final standing sheet, unchanged at EUR 13.90, 14 days, 35-day lead time, EXW. Both bidders final; German total cost EUR 176233.07 is cheapest compliant offer. Supplier explicitly prefers this structure; no further push.

trace.final_text: Accepted Demo Drehteile’s offer: €13.90/unit, 14-day payment, 35-day lead time, EXW; total cost €176,233.07.
